evidence: Market reporting heading into June 1, 2022 indicates short-term bullish momentum as Bitcoin crossed above the $32,000 resistance level for the first time since early May, supported by Glassnode data showing an accumulation trend score exceeding 0.9. While some analysts caution that the relief rally may constitute a bull trap amid broader macroeconomic headwinds and persistent regulatory pushback from central banks, the immediate on-chain accumulation and momentum tilt short-term price expectations slightly upward.
limitations: Several articles discuss broader adoption trends or longer monthly forecasts rather than specific 24-hour price dynamics.
Duplicate coverage of Argentine inflation-driven adoption was treated as a single underlying narrative.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
